intro.text: Known as the Citizen, the ruler of Urteau, who took power at the head of a coalition of skaa workers.

items.text: He and his sister Beldre were half-skaa: their noble father's wife could not have children, so she agreed that he father them with a skaa maidservant. Obligators found out around the time the Lord Ruler was killed, and in the chaos the two slipped away before they could be executed.

Built a coalition of skaa workers, took power in Urteau and named himself the Citizen. Claiming to follow Kelsier's teachings strictly, his government killed everyone in the city with noble blood within two generations.

In secret, he was also hunting Allomancers. He held their families hostage to force them to serve as his soldiers, and staged his public burnings in noble houses with hidden exits so that the chosen Allomancers could escape and join him.

Had genealogists trace everyone's ancestry, barring from office anyone without five generations of pure skaa blood, which began to divide the skaa. He kept the people content with fine wine sold for a fraction of a clip, and minted a new, nearly worthless coin, the pek.

After an execution, he saw Spook, who had slipped into Urteau, talking with Beldre and set his soldiers on him. Beldre helped two of his Pewterarms overpower Spook, and Quellion had him locked in a building and set it alight, but Spook escaped.
Quellion had a bronze spike in his upper arm, through which Ruin appeared to him as Kelsier; it gave him a Seeker's powers, letting him find Urteau's Allomancers. Spook pulled it out.

appearance.text: At first he wore skaa work clothes dyed red, the colour he required of all government officials, until he reserved blue for himself alone and took to wearing a deep blue outfit.
